4. Experiments

4.1 Dataset and Setup

We evaluate our method on CIFAR-10, a standard image classification benchmark
consisting of 60,000 32×32 color images in 10 classes, with 50,000 images for
training and 10,000 for testing. Each class has 6,000 images.

For data augmentation during training, we apply random horizontal flipping with
probability 0.5 and random crop with 4-pixel padding on the 32×32 images.
Images are normalized using channel means (0.4914, 0.4822, 0.4465) and standard
deviations (0.2470, 0.2435, 0.2616). At test time we only apply normalization
without augmentation.

We hold out 5,000 images from the official training set as a validation set
for hyperparameter tuning; the remaining 45,000 images are used for training.
